verdict.rationale: Reflect exposes a data API (OAuth2/PKCE, appending notes, listing bookmarks) but there is no documented plugin/extension SDK, plugin architecture, or sample plugin code; community commentary even highlights that Reflect deliberately avoids a plugin model (unlike Obsidian) in favor of built-in features. Probes for openapi/llms.txt docs also 404, further indicating no formal extension SDK exists.
